definitions.topology: Exact original source vertex IDs and full C source faces; no coordinate welding. Edge-connected components; simple boundary cycles require degree two.
definitions.plane: Area-integrated covariance best fit plane of finite C triangles in existing model units. Normal sign follows mean source normal; nonplanarity is descriptive, not automatic rejection.
definitions.outline: Best-plane projected finite triangle area / convex hull / minimum-area rectangle; ratios and aspect describe regularity, not user-intent validity.
definitions.full: FULL means the complete previously declared upper sitting surface, not the whole volumetric cushion. Curved/beveled rims can be part of that surface.
definitions.source_quality: Inherited pair audit only; CC/CF/FF counts remain distinct. This input audit does not rerun whole mesh intersections or certify clean source geometry.
definitions.selection: Six parent IDs fixed by prior authorized task; input qualifications only, no generated performance selection.
